'''Garis''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Tamarin sector/Legends|Tamarin sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
The planet was ruled by the [[Regent of Garis]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Regent allied with [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], despite supposedly being allied with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
